body.condition: There exist disjoint ordered row sets \((S_1)_{\mathrm{bin}},(S_2)_{\mathrm{bin}}\) and orders \(\rho_{\mathrm{bin}}\) such that \((\Gamma_{\mathrm{bin}})_{s_{\mathrm{bin}}(a,k),(\rho_{\mathrm{bin}})_a(k)}=1\) and \((\Gamma_{\mathrm{bin}})_{s_{\mathrm{bin}}(a,k),(\rho_{\mathrm{bin}})_a(\ell)}=0\) for every \(a\in\{1,2\}\), \(k\in\{1,\ldots,K\}\), and \(\ell>k\).
